article.story: Clemson (4-3) at Florida State (3-4), Oct. 31 at 7 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Florida State by 6.5. Against the spread: Florida State 3-3-1, Clemson 2-5. How to watch: ACC Network Key stats Florida State Offense Overall: 414.3 yards per game (49th in FBS) Passing: 234.1 yards per game (64th) Rushing: 180.1 yards per game (46th) Scoring: 31.6 points per game (49th) Florida State Defense Overall: 434.9 yards per game (129th in FBS) Passing: 256.3 yards per game (124th) Rushing: 178.6 yards per game (110th) Scoring: 27.9 points per game (103rd) Clemson Offense Overall: 333.1 yards per game (115th in FBS) Passing: 182.6 yards per game (115th) Rushing: 150.6 yards per game (80th) Scoring: 21.4 points per game (111th) Clemson Defense Overall: 317.0 yards per game (32nd in FBS) Passing: 185.7 yards per game (35th) Rushing: 131.3 yards per game (55th) Scoring: 21.3 points per game (49th) Clemson ranks 126th in third down percentage, converting 31.7% of the time. Clemson is 94th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 82.6% of trips. Florida State's red zone defense ranks 35th at 78.3%. Florida State is 114th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:20. Team leaders Florida State Passing: Ashton Daniels, 1,618 yards, 12 TDs, 8 INTs, 58.6 completion percentage Rushing: Ousmane Kromah, 609 yards on 114 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Duce Robinson, 407 yards on 22 catches, 4 TDs Clemson Passing: Tait Reynolds, 1,096 yards, 1 TD, 3 INTs, 66.7 completion percentage Rushing: Gideon Davidson, 492 yards on 93 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Bryant Wesco Jr., 378 yards on 34 catches, 0 TDs Last game Florida State fell 43-35 to Miami (FL) on Oct. 17. Daniels led Florida State with 298 yards on 15-of-28 passing (53.6%) for four touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball nine times for 31 yards and one rushing touchdown. Quintrevion Wisner had 63 rushing yards on nine carries, adding four receptions for 56 yards and one touchdown. Robinson had five receptions for 113 yards and two touchdowns. Clemson fell to Virginia Tech 20-16 on Oct. 24. Reynolds threw for 153 yards on 20-of-26 attempts (76.9%) with no touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 18 times for 63 yards and one rushing touchdown. Davidson had 62 rushing yards on 14 carries. Tyler Brown had eight receptions for 62 yards. Next game Florida State plays at Boston College on Nov. 7. Clemson plays at Syracuse on Nov. 7.
